title: Which course should I take?
instructions: Emre bir dil okulunda kurs seçiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; seviye, gün, süre ve fiyatı takip et.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: Hello. I want to improve my English. What courses do you have?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We have a general English course and a business English course. What is your level?

script.speaker: emre
script.text: I'm not sure. I studied English at school, but that was ten years ago.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No problem. You can do a short test online. It takes about twenty minutes.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: OK. Which course is better for my job? I work in a hotel.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then general English is better. It focuses on speaking and listening.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: There's a morning class on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, or an evening class on Tuesday and Thursday.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: I work in the mornings, so the evening class, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The course lasts ten weeks and costs three hundred pounds.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: Can I pay in two parts?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, half now and half after five weeks.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: Great. I'll do the test tonight.

questions.prompt: When did Emre study English at school?
questions.feedback: Okulda on yıl önce (ten years ago) çalışmış. Yirmi, testin dakika süresi.
questions.evidence: but that was ten years ago.

questions.prompt: Why is general English better for Emre?
options: It focuses on speaking and listening.
questions.feedback: Otelde çalışıyor; genel İngilizce konuşma ve dinlemeye odaklanıyor.
questions.evidence: It focuses on speaking and listening.

questions.prompt: Which days will Emre have classes?
questions.feedback: Sabahları çalıştığı için akşam sınıfı: salı ve perşembe.
questions.evidence: or an evening class on Tuesday and Thursday.

options: half now and half after five weeks
questions.feedback: İki taksitte: yarısı şimdi, yarısı beş hafta sonra.
questions.evidence: Yes, half now and half after five weeks.
